title: witness-log verify --json
description: The machine-readable result of `witness-log verify <dossier> --json` (Rust CLI) and `witness-log-verify --json` (Go CLI). `report` is also what the libraries return as the verifier's report: Python `verify_dossier_json`, the wasm and Node `report`, TypeScript `report`. Stability contract: fields are only ever added; an existing field keeps its name, type and meaning. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know. The wording of `failures` and `contradictions` entries is not part of the contract (whether each list is empty is). The exit status of the process equals `exit_code`.

verdict.description: The verdict in the form the text output prints.

exit_code.description: 0 WITNESSED; 11 WITNESSED by fewer than a strict majority of the trusted directory (split view possible) unless allow_sub_majority or not strict; 10 CONSISTENT-UNWITNESSED; 20 UNANCHORED; 30 DIVERGED; 40 INVALID. Usage errors exit 2 and print no JSON.

identity_pubkey.description: The dossier's own identity_pubkey field (claimed by the file, not trusted).

subject_org.description: --subject-org as given (since 0.6.0): the organisation that operates the log; its witnesses never count as independent operators.

strict.description: Exit 11 for a sub-majority WITNESSED (the default since 0.5.0).

identity_bound.description: identity_pubkey equals the checkpoint signer, and the --identity given, if any.

bindings_asserted.description: The dossier carries key bindings. False is 'not asserted', not a failure.

internally_consistent.description: Every check above passed: the file does not contradict itself.

externally_anchored.description: A trusted directory was supplied, so receipts were scored against something the verifier trusts.

split_view_unsafe.description: WITNESSED, but the counted cosigners are not a strict majority of the directory (exit 11 under strict).

contradictions.description: Why DIVERGED (a --known-head not reproduced, or an --evidence proof that verifies); empty otherwise.

known_heads_unchecked.description: Known heads larger than the dossier, which could not be checked ("<size>:<root>").

quorum.description: Null when no trusted directory was supplied.

valid_receipts.description: Distinct keys from the trusted directory whose receipt verifies.

distinct_independent_operators.description: The number WITNESSED gates on (>= 2): distinct operator_org among counted receipts, project-operated and the log's own operator excluded.

independent_operators_represented.description: Those operators, normalised (trimmed, case-folded, whitespace collapsed).

split_view_resistant.description: The counted receipts are a strict majority of the directory.

newest_trusted_witness_ms.description: Newest witnessed_at_ms among counted receipts: the freshness to trust, rather than the checkpoint's own timestamp.
